topic: Displaying manual counting data on charts
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how to display manually counted data (manual counting) for facilities on performance graphs. It was decided that this feature should be restricted to administrators only, as showing it to clients would lead to unnecessary questions regarding discrepancies.

**Display Strategy:**
The manual count data should ideally be shown as points or a line graph, especially when the granularity is hourly (hour-by-hour). If multiple facilities have manual counts, they can be represented by separate points. The system should allow administrators to select which facility's manual counting data they wish to view via filters.

**Technical Discussion:**
A separate metric for 'manual counting' was proposed to be added alongside the total traffic on the graph, specifically for admin access. Technical discussions followed regarding migrating reporting methods from queries to streaming architecture, noting complexities such as wrapping returned JSON and potential limitations with database engine features (e.g., renaming fields).
decisions: Manual counting data display is restricted to administrators only.
The manual count metric should be added to the graph alongside total traffic for admin viewing.
action_items: Further technical planning is needed to implement the streaming architecture and integrate the new manual counting metric into existing reports.
